_what: Does BattleGrid 77.1.0 move what OMEGA extracted at 61.2.0 (with the 76.0.0 funding_extreme rebuild)? One drift separates it from the 76.x records: 76.1.0 d9cde5d0 -> 77.1.0 7c4bbe09 at 2026-10-02T04:07:19Z (a MAJOR bump). ANSWER: no, at the name level AND at the parameter level. This is the first drift record that reads every signal definition live instead of relying on the name comparison.

method.liveSource: battlegrid-manager system_state["surface_tools"] (watch job capture), saved as tests/fixtures/2026-10-02-surface-77.1.0/ in the manager repository (read as UTF-8); plus 84 get_strategy_signal_definition reads through the manager's read client
method.storedSource: data/contract/ (this repo, _manifest.json servedContractVersion 61.2.0, extractedOn 2026-09-20) and data/derived/signal_module_map.json defaultParams (rebuilt for 76.0.0 on 2026-10-01)

drifts.note: By stored field only create_intelligence_agent and update_intelligence_agent moved (tradingConfig: maxLeverage number -> integer, descriptions). The other seven moved in their output schema only. Official changelog v77 (main aca6dfbd): agent risk rules. There is no v77.1 entry.

parameterLevel.conclusion: Every served defaultParams equals data/derived/signal_module_map.json defaultParams; no signal parameter was renamed, added or removed.

authoringToolsTouched: compile_strategy_plan and preview_strategy_report changed by hash with identical stored fields (input schema, annotations, description), so their output schemas moved. What moved is not documented and not recoverable: the manager stored no output schema before this review.
conclusion: Across 61.2.0 -> 77.1.0 none of the three authoring enums moved, and at 77.1.0 no signal parameter differs from the mirror. OMEGA's extraction is NOT invalidated.
notMeasured: The compile path was not exercised (no compile was run), so an output-shape change in compile_strategy_plan that OMEGA's record mode depends on would not show here. Metric-level parameters (get_metric_construction_hints per metric) were not re-read. The vendor pack is behind (installed 31.2.56, npm 31.2.60).
